selectedFunctions.label: Estate Protocol claim own checkpoint-based property dividend
warnings: Static source/deployment/ABI metadata only, not live authorization, persistent runtime identity, backing, financial safety, liquidity, successful execution or a complete workflow. Independent grants, pauses, policies and canonical calldata/value controls remain mandatory; zero native value required.

Arbitrum AUSTINEP23 dividend module only, discovered from the current primary marketplace property token 0x17af69414ebaeeafbd8e00bc7b223a0b7330578c via getModulesByType(4). Current proxy implementation is 0x5968ad21e06213d3df7c6bd65bc8dbd4f33f1c1a, resolved from source-defined storage slot 11 and owner-context eth_call implementation(). Root explorer source is PARTIAL verification; implementation Sourcify creation/runtime are exact_match. No exact-match relabeling of the root.

pullDividendPayment(index) pays only msg.sender according to that holder's property-token balance at the recorded checkpoint, not current balance or a user-supplied recipient. Eligibility/exclusion and claimed flags, non-reclaimed status, maturity <= now < expiry, and not-paused state all apply. No KYC or operator grant is added; property token purchase/onboarding is outside this scope.

Gross claim floors balanceOfAt(msg.sender,checkpointId) * dividend.amount / dividend.totalSupply. Withholding floors gross * withholdingTax[msg.sender] / 1e18; the holder receives gross minus withheld, and withheld amount remains tracked for issuer withdrawal. Distribution token is per dividend; observed index 0 uses native Arbitrum USDC 0xaf88d065e77c8cc2239327c5edb3a432268e5831 with 6 decimals. This is finite funded dividend accounting, not a fixed rent/APY promise.

Claimed flag and claimedAmount accounting are updated before ERC20 transfer; a zero entitlement can still be marked claimed. Withholding, dates, exclusion defaults, wallet, pause state and proxy implementation are mutable by privileged parties. Expired unclaimed funds can be reclaimed by issuer; no indefinite claim right or queue/payout-time guarantee exists.

At observation dividend index 0 matures 2025-12-15T23:12:00Z and expires 2026-12-15T23:13:00Z, has not been reclaimed, and paused() is false. These are point-in-time source/state anchors, not a continuing execution promise. Current marketplace retains this property and current frontend invokes pullDividendPayment for rent claims.

Property token/checkpoint bookkeeping, asset custody, legal claims, property valuation and future income are not independently attested. Current Palm Crest STO subscription was reviewed but its isOpen() is false and end date elapsed, so no expired subscription method is activated. Investor self-claim is not issuer dividend creation, push-payment authority, asset rescue or token transfer capability.

primaryMarketplaceProperty.name: The Johnson II
primaryMarketplaceProperty.address: Single Family Residence in Austin, Texas
primaryMarketplaceProperty.details: The Johnson II is a one-of-a-kind mid-century modern Airbnb designed by renowned Austin architect AD Stenger, featuring 5 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms across 2,400 sq ft in the highly desirable Zilker Park neighborhood,just steps from Barton Springs and Austin City Limits. With over a year of verified operational history, a 5-star average rating, and over 50% of 2025 already booked, the property is projected to generate $300,000 in bookings in Year 1. It comes fully furnished with over $110,000 in high-end pieces and includes luxury amenities such as a heated pool, outdoor kitchen, top-tier appliances, and parking for four vehicles. Acquired privately at more than 2% below asking price, The Johnson II is a turnkey, income-producing asset in one of Austin’s most iconic locations.

Buy, Sell & Trade tokenized real estate in minutes using your USDC. Estate Protocol is a tokenized real estate marketplace built on Arbitrum. **Here’s how you can get started with your journey to build a global real estate portfolio.**\ \ **Step 1** - Visit [www.estateprotocol.com](http://www.estateprotocol.com) and tap on Enter to login. ![](https://1491657726-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2FzYvQhVdSCe9ZELNRL3Cu%2Fuploads%2FbCmDrvPwEGmnxBx44z8f%2F1.png?alt=media\&token=31aca135-b94c-4b13-820d-a7a81ef5f154)
**Step 2** - For wallet users: If you have a wallet, you can directly login through your Metamask or coinbase wallet or use wallet connect. For non-wallet users: You can login directly using email or gmail and a wallet will be created for you. \ ![](https://1491657726-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2FzYvQhVdSCe9ZELNRL3Cu%2Fuploads%2FDXgEMb6LkoSufxvWuVAV%2F2.png?alt=media\&token=91696ad2-39c3-4e89-9e50-d9d952cb7a8d) **Step 3 -** Once your account is created, complete your KYC. Tap on the KYC option in your My Account section. ![](https://1491657726-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2FzYvQhVdSCe9ZELNRL3Cu%2Fuploads%2Fs5IRFBvODcMrkm2E9sB1%2F4.png?alt=media\&token=56265579-d665-4141-a8e1-5e38ec5f4a79)
**Step 4** - You’ll see this screen once your KYC gets approved. It usually only takes a couple of minutes to get your KYC approved. ![](https://1491657726-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2FzYvQhVdSCe9ZELNRL3Cu%2Fuploads%2Fa10IDluTEgeHEesMPeHv%2F6.png?alt=media\&token=c4a7df99-ca68-4145-82d3-24a1ecb2f8bd)
**Step 5** - Once your KYC is approved, head to the Marketplace from the top menu. ![](https://1491657726-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2FzYvQhVdSCe9ZELNRL3Cu%2Fuploads%2FvTE7IZHoYXBCcUBObhm0%2F7.png?alt=media\&token=954715b6-d618-4c7d-84dc-59fd5363f945) **Step 6 -** Check the list of available properties in the marketplace. DYOR and choose the one you want to invest in. ![](https://1491657726-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2FzYvQhVdSCe9ZELNRL3Cu%2Fuploads%2FmWQvG0ez850vS006lcMG%2F8.png?alt=media\&token=f0e2d2b2-5b49-45b3-a9fe-828bad35c491) \ **Step 7** - Check the details of the property you want to buy. You can check the financials, documentation, location and photos of the property. ![](https://1491657726-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2FzYvQhVdSCe9ZELNRL3Cu%2Fuploads%2Fa1hwfqjuIPnLqqT3Xe1T%2F9.png?alt=media\&token=4c97e414-659f-45c4-a103-0527e8f7a909)
**Step 8** - Enter the number of tokens you want to purchase. Complete your purchase using USDC in your wallet. ![](https://1491657726-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2FzYvQhVdSCe9ZELNRL3Cu%2Fuploads%2FuadMb2rCSmjMALybx4mO%2F10.png?alt=media\&token=7de0c650-ab36-420e-a7d8-09d56ce5f91a) **Step 9** - Share with your friends and family (if you want). ![](https://1491657726-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2FzYvQhVdSCe9ZELNRL3Cu%2Fuploads%2F1A9Uy5jSAZtZzyHEFNi6%2F11.png?alt=media\&token=895a1b64-fe51-44b5-b425-ec4af5cdf93d) **Step 10** - Once your property generates rent, tap on claim rent. Start earning rental income on the tokens you purchased. ![](https://1491657726-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2FzYvQhVdSCe9ZELNRL3Cu%2Fuploads%2FzS2LRcnlFHXKVO90k1Yz%2F13.png?alt=media\&token=bc04216b-e204-4050-966f-dcb5d1faa93f)
